payload.subject: Re: Negotiation Call with TechSavvy Innovations
payload.body_text:
Hello Omar,

Thanks for the detailed overview. The team found the walkthrough of TechSavvy's EDA Expansion useful, and it has sparked a good discussion here about where it could fit into our current processes. There is genuine interest in moving forward, provided the practical details work out.

Could you send over any additional documentation you have on implementation and support? A short summary of what a typical rollout looks like would also be welcome. Once we have that, I suggest we schedule a follow-up meeting to talk through the specifics.

Many thanks,

Elena Vasiliev
TechSavvy Innovations
